fCWTr: Fast Continuous Wavelet Transform

Source: R/fCWTr-package.R
fCWTr-package.Rd

Enables the usage of the fast continuous wavelet transform, originally implemented in the 'C++' library 'fCWT' by Lukas Arts. See Arts, P.A. and Van den Broek, E.L. (2022) doi:10.1038/s43588-021-00183-z for details.
